decision.reason: [ev-1a93967aa9fb] is a single changelog bullet under Bug fixes that names the area (logs, anonymous usage) and otherwise just links to PR #10579. It doesn't say what was "cumulative": a log line logged repeatedly, or usage data sent more than once. It also doesn't say which configuration triggers the behaviour, for example whether anonymous usage reporting has to be enabled, so no applicability condition can be written. To settle the open applicability aspect we need the PR description or diff, showing the code path and the setting that controls it.
